## Can we do this with MLIR? {#circt-route}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="36%"}
The CIRCT core dialects make the concepts we just used explicit:

- **`hw`**: structure and hierarchy
- **`comb`**: combinational logic
- **`seq`**: state

::: {.fragment}
CIRCT also contains other hardware dialects, transformations, analyses, and
tools.

[Next: use the tools.]{.marker}
